summary_md: **René · NeuroPixel+ ([@leretahx](https://x.com/leretahx/status/2116141179133739308))** releases **ComfyUI-RenderPasses**, which extracts compositing passes (depth, normals, albedo, parallax, Cryptomatte from PSD layers, 3D splat) from existing 2D background art without altering it ([neuropixelplus/ComfyUI-RenderPasses](https://github.com/neuropixelplus/ComfyUI-RenderPasses)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - neuropixelplus/ComfyUI-RenderPasses: Turn flat 2D background plates into compositing-ready render passes (depth, normals, albedo, parallax, position, Cryptomatte from PSD layers, 3D splat) as a multilayer EXR + Nuke script, with open-weights models in ComfyUI.
